Keyur-Commentary/ब्रह्म.title: ब्रह्म
Keyur-Commentary/ब्रह्म.content:
ब्रह्म सही है या ब्रम्ह?
मूल वैदिक  उच्चारण ब्रम्ह[^1] था, परंतु लिखते समय ब्रह्म के रूप में लिखा जाता है। परिकल्पना यह है कि वैदिक काल में संस्कृत एक बोली जाने वाली भाषा थी। लेखन को कनिष्ठ माना जाता था क्योंकि बोली मे भव, आरोह अवरोह, स्वर, विराम के चलते अर्थ समृद्ध थआ और लेखन नीरस एवं शुष्क थआ।
लेखन किसी न किसी रूप में तब स्वीकार लिया गया , जब सरस्वती सभ्यता का व्यापारी संपर्क सुमेरियों (middle east) से हुआ।
यह लेखन क्यूनिफ़ॉर्म से प्रभावित था किन्तु बहोत सारी middle east लिपि की खिचड़ी जैसा था। हमे सरस्वती संस्कृति मे जो  seal मिल रहे है वह ये व्यापार की खिचड़ी लिपि मे लिखे गए है। बहारी / म्लेच्छ के व्यापार के अलावा, वैदिक समाज मे कनिष्ठ होने के कारण लेखन का प्रचालन नहीं था।
सुमेरकी भाषा मे क्यूनिफ़ॉर्म मे लिखते समय  शब्द के अंत में “ह” नहीं लिखा जाता था। परिणामस्वरूप ये व्यापारी लेखन मे ब्रम्ह  का लिखित रूप ब्रह्म बन गया। आगे चलकर, 2000-1500 BC मे जब सरस्वती नदी लुप्त होने लगि और वैदिक समाज सरस्वती से अन्य प्रदेशों मे जाने लगा तो पूर्वानुपूर्व श्रुति को बचाने के लिए लेखन अधिक व्यापक रूप से अपनाया गया और कालक्रम मे middle eastern scrip के साथ व्यापार मे रूढ हुई लिपि मे से ब्राह्मी[^2] लिपि विकसित हुई। तब  यह गलत लेखन स्थायी हो गया.
[^1]  : इस वैदिक परंपरा से चले आ रहे “रुद्रम्  नमकम्” पाठमे प्रथम श्लोक मे ब्रम्ह का उच्चारण  सुने (www.youtube.com/watch)
[^2] : revistes.uab.cat/indialogs/article/view/v10-pillai/213-pdf-en

Keyur-Commentary/लकार-V2.title: लकार V2
Keyur-Commentary/लकार-V2.content:
First Stage of लकार evolution
ल is sand/shore. ङ is periphery as seen from shore. You can assume ङ to be high tide mark. ट is sand mound (टीला) or basket made to trap food during tide. ट could have been or evolved in a Coracle from basket.
We are in a Homo society that has yet not developed conception of time. Drives are limbic. Language consists of sentences made up of couple of phonemes. Main use of language is to communicate for hunt, dominance or reproduction.
लकार evolved not as temporal markers but as food marker. It evolved into a temporal marker because tides were time bound.
1 लुङ् = ल उ ङ Sand outward ङ = area towards sea from high tide mark
high tide is over and steady ground is there = food in inter tidal zone is available. अद्यतन means edible and भूत means steady ground accomplished. भुज् has arisen from this context and refers to wide/open steady ground.
लुङ् is food replenishment with each tide. twice a day. It is an annuity without efforts and started causing Homo to stay put in the location.
2 लिट = Sand inward (from) ट
Because टीला holds water,  the steady ground is not visible (but is there.) In anticipation this became परोक्ष भूत.
3 लेट = ल ए ट = sand संप्रदान टीला / Coracle
लेट means संप्रदान into  ट- receive (food) into ट. It may also mean gather sand into ट.
This is “do this to get that”or “may it be”  mood and does not refer to time.
4 लुट = sand outward ट.
This is tide receding completely. Not only this is time of  inedible food, it also means food will be available in future only. So लुट means future with fair degree of certainty. This certainty element comes from certainty of tides.
5 लिङ
लिङ = ल इ ङ = sand inward (of) high tide line
Sand beyond high tide line has no chance of getting food and was used for teaching the process.
Hence लिङ was associated with blessing or process instruction.
Alternate meaning: sand below periphery (of boat) when used with तिङ्. Now all लकार are used with verbs तिङ् but initially - before verb subject distinction got crystalized - लकार were place markets as well. When they became action markers - तिङ् interpretation became dominant.
In the second phase floating devices were invented which had to be described differently
6 लृट्
This refers to place inside Coracle afloat. It indicated that food is available in future. But there is no certainty like tide based food.
7 लृङ्
This pertains to situation where instrument is coracle but place if high tide line. This came to mean “IF coracle has cought food THEN we will get it”; so it evolved to mean हेतुहेतुमद्भाव
8 लङ
shoreline is at the high tide level.
Food is not available + steady ground.
9 लट
shire line is at low tide level. Means वर्तमान
10 लोट्
means sand detach from basket. This is maintenance instruction ?
लट् - वर्तमान
sand here ट
Shore line at coracle.
अ - here/at, is plotted on time dimension.
Comment: It is not clear whether it is inward tide or outward. But I believe it is reference to outward tide because context is edible. Whether ट meant coracle or some other instrument of fishing is yet undecided. But calling it Coracle helps me understand and explain concepts as much as some other tool would. It is very unlikely it emerged as coracle. As shore based fishing must predate intentional boat making by a big margin. Whatever that ट, by the time of लृट् it evolved in a coracle type thing. Also by this time temporal conception with ल+ट and  ल + ङ was strong enough to name it लृट् and not ट ऋ.
लिट्- परोक्ष – भूत
लिट् = ल इ ट = shore-inward-coracle/ट
भू+क्त - steady up accomplished
Tide is gone hence unseen past

लुट् =  ल उ ट
shore/sand-outward-coracle/ट
उ - outward - is plotted on time dimension.
Comment: The  reference point for time is eating and eating is linked to tide. Because Tides re-occur, entire concept of time is re-occurring in cycles.
लृट् भविष्य

shore-superior-coracle
comment: लृट् is totally different way of getting food and is not reallty tide related. it is not in अ इ उ dimension but in ऋ - ऌ dimension.
Both लुट and लृट् have “inedible right now” - अनद्यतन - sense. लुट is more certain the way tides are certain. It is very  tightly bound to अनद्यतन sense.
लृट् is more uncertain in general. “It is also not very tightly bound to अनद्यतन sense.

Keyur-Commentary/लकारV1.title: लकारV1
Keyur-Commentary/लकारV1.content:
लकार V1
Fishing has started using the entangled water-vines with floaters (त) at one end and sinker stones(क) at the other end. In this era, the understanding of time evolved in the context of high and low tides. The understanding evolved as follows -
लङ्
लङ् means ल ङ, Sand periphery/outside (is visible) – tide long gone. Hence लङ्  means अन-अद्यतन भूत काल.
लुङ्
लुङ् means ल उ ङ, Sand up periphery (is visible) – Tide has recently receded but where sand is up - mounds - it is visible but not entire periphery. Hence लुङ् means सामान्य भूत काल.
लीङ्
लीङ् means ल इ ङ, Sand below periphery/outside. This is the desired state because this state brings in food. This could have meant वर्तमान. But circuitry for desire was unlabled and circuitry to distinguish and lable वर्तमान[^1] was low priority. Hedespitete of meaning exactly same in real world, लीङ् indicates desire and not वर्तमान. At this stage differentiation between one’s own desire and desire of society are not differentiated so विधलीङ् and आशिर्लीङ् have not yet evolved and there is only लीङ्.
After some time, who knows how much, a mechanism was deviced to identify when high tide will occur. Hollow coconut (ट) was used as a bowl to make a mound ot sand somewhere in the intertidal zone. We are yet in a phase where कर्ता, कर्म, करण, क्रियापद differentiation has not evolved. So the bowl, mound, act of creating a mound, creater of a mound - all are called ट.  Other लकार evolved in context of this ट. I beiइ eve hollow coconut was place a top this mound (वाट). This mound, over a period of time should have evolved into a weir/enclosure, increasing catch.
लट
लट means ल ट, sand mound (वाट) is seen. High tide is on going. Assumption here is entire mound is not seen only top is seen.
लीट
लीट means ल इ ट,  sand below mound. Mound is disintegrated or ट is dislodged from mound. So the tide has receded. लङ् also indicates this state. So “not seen” is hue added to लीट to distinguish it from लङ्.
लुट
लुट means ल उ ट = sand up mound is visible. This indicates tide has not yet compl;eted high tide cycle. But is is certainly, decisively is hapenning.
लृट
लृट means ल ऋ ट, sand superior mound is visible - the mound is intact. So tide has not occurred nor it is underway. So This too says Tide lies in future. But has more uncertainty about when and if it will occur.
लेट
लेट = ल ए ट, means sampradan (sand) bowl/mound, that is, receive/connect sand bowl. It refers to a state of being/emotion we are not accustomed to. It is desire[^2] but in a different state of mind.
लोट
लोट, ल ओ ट, means apaadan (sand) bowl, that is, detach sand from bowl.
आज्ञा (आ ज्ञ आ) means upto here widen surface. It referred to dismentaling mound.
लृङ्
लृङ् ल ऋ ङ sand superior outside, has been added later on only to complete the set. In reality, if sand is superior outside, there is no tide. It came to be used in the sense “Because there is no sea, there is no tide” sense.
Comments -
लकार is proof that more matters to us than past present and future. They are -

What could have been only if…
What is certain about the future just because the process has started and what is not so certain
Desire - of self and society, though  differentialtion between these two was not there at begining
Seen and derived are different. These innocent people yet had no concept of not seen, not real but told to be so.
Sense of mastery


Other observations


Time is cyclical. Because tides repeat. भूत and भविष्य refer to the same sand coming out of sea; time is a circular aspect.

Word for feeling in modern day context would be somewhat like what Steve would have felt when the Apple-1 generated colourful dot in TV screen. “master of the universe” feeling sort of. “I can do” feeling. being in phase with nature.
लेट describes wishing in this state of mind.

Keyur-Commentary/लेट-Shift.title: लेट Shift
Keyur-Commentary/लेट-Shift.content:
लेट् and the Roots of Reference
Folio entry — brainstorm log

1. Starting point: two timelines
Object permanence (ability to mentally represent a real, concrete object that is not currently perceptible):

Ontogeny: rudimentary at ~8 months (error-prone), reliable for visible displacements by ~12–18 months, full (invisible-displacement) permanence by ~18–24 months.
Phylogeny: not a single inherited trait. Convergently evolved — independently in mammals and in birds (corvids, some parrots), lineages that split ~300+ million years ago. Within primates specifically, full (stage-6) permanence is reliably shown across the whole great-ape clade (chimps, bonobos, gorillas, orangutans) and only inconsistently in monkeys and prosimians — best treated as a great-ape-clade-level capacity in this lineage, likely present by the last common ancestor of great apes (~13–16 mya) or at least of Pan/Homo (~6–7 mya), rather than traceable to a much deeper ancestor.
Method note: this is inference from the distribution of the trait across living relatives (comparative method + parsimony), not fossil-dated observation — which is as good as it gets for a purely cognitive trait. Brain-case/endocast evidence on prefrontal expansion can serve as an indirect, correlated check, but not a direct date.

Vocal-auditory communication:

Ontogeny: auditory system functional prenatally (cochlea mature ~20 weeks gestation, behavioral responsiveness by third trimester); cooing ~6–8 weeks; vocal play ~4–6 months; canonical babbling ~6–8 months, drifting toward native-language sound patterns by ~9–12 months. This is a genuine auditory-vocal loop, not motor output alone — shown by babbling being shaped by auditory input/feedback, and by deaf infants showing delayed/reduced vocal babbling while showing manual babbling when exposed to sign.
Phylogeny: anatomically ancient and widespread across vertebrates — sound production/audition in fish and amphibians, long predating the amniote split.

Conclusion from the two timelines: meaningful vocal communication precedes object permanence, both ontogenetically and (on comparative, non-recapitulationist grounds) phylogenetically.
2. What that ordering implies about reference

Saussurean reference = an arbitrary sign standing for a signified that need not be perceptually present. This requires holding an absent referent in mind — exactly what object permanence supplies.
Therefore: a communication system operating before object permanence exists cannot be Saussurean-referential. There is no representational slot yet for “the thing this sound stands for, which isn’t here.”
What such a system can be: indexical. Signal tightly bound to a present, perceptible state (cf. vervet monkey alarm calls — “functionally referential,” not symbolically referential, per Seyfarth, Cheney & Marler 1980). Meaning is fused with the present moment, not detachable from it.

3. Sound as constitutive of presence, not a pointer beyond it

In an indexical, pre-permanence system, hearing/producing a sound is not “inferring an absent thing.” Both sender and receiver need no permanence at all for the system to work — nothing in it requires representing an absence.
The occurrence of the sound is itself taken as evidence of the object’s/state’s presence — not a symbol pointing elsewhere, but part of the same undifferentiated present. Producing a sound in the absence of the physical object is, for this mind, equivalent to the object’s presence in whatever reality-state the utterance occupies.

4. What tense would this sound like, translated into modern grammar?

Tense and mood are devices for marking a gap between utterance-time/reality and event-time/reality (past = before now, future = not yet, irrealis/subjunctive = not necessarily actual). All of them presuppose representing an event as distinct from the present perceptual state — exactly what a pre-permanence mind cannot do.
So the predicted form is not simple present tense (which is itself one term in an opposition against past/future/hypothetical). It’s a form that is tense-and-mood neutral by necessity — not through economy, but because the opposing categories don’t exist to be elided from. Such a form should be usable, unchanged, wherever a modern language would need several different tenses/moods, because for the system producing it, “was / is / will be / may be” were never four options — only one undifferentiated condition.

5. लेट् as a structural correspondence

लेट् (one of the ten लकार in Sanskrit grammar): archaic, rare, confined almost entirely to Vedic, described by the grammatical tradition as interchangeable with domains otherwise covered by other लकार (subjunctive-/injunctive-like uses among them), lacking the fixed tense/mood value assigned to the regular लकार system (Whitney 1889; Macdonell 1916).
This is a feature-for-feature match to what §4 predicts a grammaticalized trace of tense-mood-undifferentiated utterance would look like.
Scope of the claim, stated carefully: this is a structural correspondence, not a historical/derivational one. Not claiming लेट् literally descends from a pre-permanence signal system — that’s a stronger claim than the evidence supports, and standard alternative explanations (eroded archaic category, grammarians’ residual class for irregular forms, dialectal variation) remain live and unaddressed. What’s being claimed: लेट्’s indeterminacy is exactly the signature a surviving trace of that stage would carry, if there were one. Left open for philological work: how and why.

6. Correcting the closure logic: experience vs. perception

Original (wrong) framing: object permanence closes off the indexical mode once it emerges — “impossible to perceive/express once object permanence sets in.”
Why that’s wrong: object permanence adds a capacity; it doesn’t delete the older one. Indexical processing is deep-rooted enough to persist alongside referential capacity for a long stretch after the latter becomes available — and to dominate over it whenever both are active for a given stimulus. (Note: modern one-way experience→sound expression — pain cries, gasps, laughter — is NOT valid evidence for this persistence, because it’s a different, one-way channel that never completes into a two-way referential loop. It’s orthogonal to this argument, not supporting evidence for it.)
The real distinction needed: experience vs. perception.

Experience = what limbic neurons register. A sound generates a state functionally equivalent to the object’s actual presence — no separate representational tag marking the sound-triggered state as different from what the object’s real presence would produce. This is the indexical mode.
Perception = what is carried by cortical processing. A sound triggers a symbolic/conceptual tag about the object — representationally detached from the object’s own presence. This is the referential mode.
As long as sound → experience remains possible, it will dominate/supersede sound → perception whenever both are active. The mere cortical availability of perception does not retire limbic experience.



7. The corrected terminus post quem (TPQ) for लेट्

Not: the point referential capacity became available (too early, too weak — doesn’t close the loop).
Actual condition: the point at which the sound → experience pathway itself becomes impossible — hearing a sound can no longer generate limbic, experiential activation of the absent object, only cortical, symbolic perception of it.
Only after this closure does speech processing become predominantly cortex-centric rather than limbic-driven — and only then could a residual, tense-mood-undifferentiated form become identifiable as a distinct, marked, archaic category (i.e., as लेट्) standing apart from a now-dominant referential system.
Reframing: लेट् is not a fossil of the stage that ended when object permanence began. It’s a fossil of a stage that ended considerably later — when the limbic sound-to-experience channel itself finally closed.

8. Loose thread: hemisphere lateralization

The proposed limbic → cortical shift in speech processing plausibly tracks onto the standard right-hemisphere/left-hemisphere lateralization story: right hemisphere more limbic-connected, more prosodic/affective; left hemisphere more cortical, more propositional/referential (in most humans).
If the neurolinguistic lateralization literature offers an independent, testable proxy for the timing/degree of this shift, it could check the TPQ argument against something other than लेट्’s internal grammar alone. Not yet developed — flagged for later.

9. To do / open questions

State the experience/perception distinction as an explicit operational definition before this reaches reviewers — as it stands it risks reading as an unfalsifiable phenomenological claim rather than a neuro-functional one.
Is there comparative/developmental literature on limbic vs. cortical weighting in vocal-auditory processing specifically (not general emotion/cognition lateralization) that could anchor this beyond लेट्-internal evidence?
Does the limbic→cortical speech-processing shift have any expected relationship to the great-ape-clade object permanence window (§1), or is it a fully separate, much later (hominin-specific?) event? Not yet resolved.

(This is a hypothesis.  It will take more work to prove it to others. I dont have time or energy, at present, to prove it partly because, for me, this is sufficiently proven, and partly because I have so much to work on, this has moved to low priority once i have conviction.)
Identifying a sound sequence to belong to a uniquely identifiable class (वर्ण) is essential to communicate thru sound.
The cognitive unit in which sound is classified is वर्ण.
When Hominina split from Homininae, for some reason, the temporal (time) length of वर्ण that can be uniquely identified, reduced, compared to other Homoninidae like Panini.
As a result, multiple वर्ण could be held in temporary working memory.
This enabled the use of multiple वर्ण-समास to be fit in working memory.
वर्ण-समास is not a वर्ण but a pointer to set of वर्ण.
This is equivalent to the invention of a pointer as a variable.
This is recursion.
Selection bias in evolution resulted in this recursively to strengthen over generations and eventually become totally abstract and limitless.
I believe this happened through 1BGCT loops. Genetics gives infrastructure but does not activate the potential. That depends on exposure to language.
संज्ञा revolution is this ability to “refer” to a bundled meaning. Ability to treat the bundle as an object without unpacking its contents.
When _Homo Erecrus became aware ofthis ability to name/point things, he called it bundling - संज्ञा.
The usage (of word संज्ञा)  as an abstract concept eventually erased this original physical meaning of संज्ञा as a “bundle.”

Keyur-Commentary/ह्वे-Explained.title: ह्वे Explained
Keyur-Commentary/ह्वे-Explained.content:
Object Permanence, Indexical Sound, and ह्वे
Context
All Sanskrit words are made from Paninian elements like धातु, प्रत्यय, उपसर्ग etc. and meanings are derived from these elements.  Similarly, these elements are also made of and derive meaning from constituent वर्ण.  Meanings of वर्ण are deciphered and given in शिव सूत्र. One such धातु is ह्वे. Its literal meaning can be checked at ह्वे. ह्वे is a very important milestone in human cognition as explained below.
The cognition of things that exist only in speech, led to worlds that exist only in speech.
Object permanence
Object permanence is the cognitive capacity to represent an object as continuing to exist even when it is no longer perceived — out of sight, out of hearing, out of touch. Developmentally, it emerges gradually in infancy (classically associated with Piaget’s sensorimotor stage). Phylogenetically, it is not a human-specific trait; it appears in varying degrees across species, and its full form depends on cortical structures capable of holding a symbolic “tag” for an absent referent.
Absence of object permanence in early language
Before this capacity is in place — ontogenetically in the infant, and phylogenetically in early hominin communication — a sound cannot function as a reference to something absent, because there is no stable mental representation of “the object, even when not present” for the sound to point to. Referential (Saussurean) signs presuppose exactly this: a signifier standing for a signified that can be entertained independently of the signifier’s occurrence.
What remains possible without object permanence is indexical communication: a sound whose occurrence is not a pointer to something else, but is itself functionally equivalent to the presence of the thing. The cry, call, or utterance does not mean “predator is here” in the referential sense — its occurrence is the predator’s presence, processed directly. There is no gap between sign and referent for the system to bridge, because no such gap can yet be represented.
Realism of heard/spoken sound as indexical meaning
This indexical mode is not metaphorical shorthand — it describes a real, more primitive processing pathway: a limbic “experience” pathway in which a heard or spoken sound is functionally equivalent to the object’s presence, as opposed to the later cortical “perception” pathway, which holds a symbolic tag about the object independent of any given occurrence. The indexical mode does not vanish the moment object permanence emerges; it persists in parallel until this limbic pathway closes. Grammatically, communication built on this mode would be expected to be tense-and-mood neutral — there is no “was,” “will be,” or “might be” for something whose sound-occurrence is its existence.
ह्वे — literal meaning and fit
ह्वे is read here as “existence received (in) speech” — not “to call/summon” in the derived, referential sense given by standard dictionaries, but the more primitive claim underlying that later gloss: the existence of a thing arrives, is received, in the very event of speech-sound. This is a near-literal statement of the indexical mechanism above — sound-occurrence functioning as received presence, not as a symbol referring to an absent presence.
Read this way, ह्वे is not merely compatible with the pre-object-permanence indexical hypothesis; it is a lexical fossil of it — a word whose root sense names the exact mechanism (existence-via-received-speech) that the hypothesis predicts must have preceded referential language. Later derived senses (“call, summon, invoke”) are the referential-era narrowing of this older, structurally tense/mood-neutral indexical core.

index.title: index
index.content:
Introduction

All sentences (वाक्य) are made of, and derive meaning from, constituent words (पद/शब्द).
All पद/शब्द are made up of, and derive their meaning from, वर्ण.  This is why Sanskrit is a special language
वर्ण have/had their own specific meanings from which पद/शब्द derive their meanings.
Intrinsic meaning of वर्ण arose from brain circuitry existing in species in which particular वर्ण emerged. It is likely that different वर्ण emerged during the reign of different species as the evolution of Hominins (starting from Great Apes) and the evolution of language occurred hand in hand.
These original intrinsic meanings of वर्ण are unknown at present. Because Sanskrit words derive their meanings from constituent वर्ण, it is possible to decipher the original intrinsic meanings of वर्ण.
I have a working cypher. It is WIP but working sufficiently enough as a proof of concept.
Once the cypher is established beyond doubt, it will improve our understanding of श्रुति and स्मृति.
In the process, we will also know a lot about the history of our ancestors.
From primary findings, I believe, our oral traditions have the history of a few lakh years preserved, going back to at least Homo Erectus.

I am working on fine-tuning the Cypher. This site is made to share that work.

ख क = hollow is to be read a maneuver
फ प = footing-less is to be read as footing/rope/leg
छ च = many/drill/loose is to be read as again/circle/knot
ठ ट =  low ground is to be read as basket/टीला
थ त = platform/step up us to be read as float/that
घ ग = hunted is to be read as live
झ ज = vibrating/hesitant is to be read as wide/jump/open
ढ ड = useless is to be read as fear/predator
ध द  = carry/hold/bear is to be read as give/roll
भ ब = steady/standing/unbound is to be read as bound
comment- The idea is something like this - if act is to be done again and again and if it is said to be घ hunted at the begining itself; you need to read as living. If act is to be done again and again, and it is said to be empty at the begining you need to read as maneuver/hand. because the start state/action of maneuver/living is prerequisite to arrive at empty/hunted at the end.

AV: कृत्
Language Meaning: After a verb ending in a consonant but preceded by इ , उ or ऋ -long or short, and after the verbs ज्ञा ‘to know’, श्री ‘to please’ and कॄ ‘to scatter’, comes the affix क (अ)।
Literal Meaning:
inward verb(fish/live) rope carry open net upto object(reed) hand-held inward water exist hard hold exist
comment
इगु - verb(inward) object(fish/live) has become इगु. Because इ is crystalized as सुप् and तिङ्.
उ meant outward and was adopted as क्रिया विभक्ति (from डुकृञ् / भू) meant all verbs were outward facing.
इ meant inward and was adopted as objectifying विभक्ति (from इष?) - all objectifications are inward centric.
It is possible that because action was outward facing since time of LUCA, it evolved as उ and because objectification was inward centric it emerged as इ. and by inference we can say अ existed before emergence of उ इ.
One this is certain तिङ् emerged from उ and सुप् from इ. and all धातु are अ - that has both inward or outward contained within.

3.1.37  दयायासश्च
SV: दयायासः च
AV: लिटि आम्
Language meaning : After the words दय ‘to give’, ‘to go’ and ‘to protect’, अय ‘to go’ and आस ‘to sit’, there is the affix आम् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows
Literal:
AV : (if) sand mound below (s)till inside (water)
roll join untill join untill gather indeed long circle
Commentary
Given assumption that Erectus had limited control over मात्रा and स्वरितत्व and absence of आ , Originally these were pronounced as - द अ य अ अ य अ अ स अ श च. entire thing could have taken 3 to 4 breath cycles as per my estimation based on average length of धातु being 2/3 वर्ण. No wonder लाघव was very important, not only from memory perspective but also effort per communication point of view also.

अनुवृत्ति : सन्
Language Meaning: The affix सन् comes after the verbs मान ‘to honour’, बध् ‘to bind’, दान् ‘to cut’, and शान् ‘to whet’, and long ई is the substitute of इ of the reduplicate (7.4.79 and 6.1.4) syllable.
Literal Meaning:
fish (or marine food) at (pull (in tide) contain carry and roll/give (erect on ground) (from pull (tide) steady connect)sश्च  
Meaning 7.7.26
म अ न ब ध द अ न श अ ओ of  (न भ य ) द इ र घ श्च अ भ य अ स स य
Meaning explained: continuing from previous sutra (roll…)- inside till bound by pull, carry till roll, pull erect unless detaches pull steady connect - rolling water ca erect walk till ground connect align gathered joins
fish up to pull contain carry give up to  (pull long un till) अपादान (pull steady connects) - roll inward superior hunt elomngate repeat up tp steady connect un till align gathered join
physical meaning :
interpretation 1: This is too long to decipher the physical meaning. Because even if each वर्ण has 4 potential meanings (2 root meanings and 2 कीभक्ति - संज्ञा and क्रिया), total potential meanings are 4.7 *10^21 with 36 वर्ण sequence.
Interpretation 2: Though mathematically there are many meanings possible, most of those meanings converge and are not unique or random. Besides, the human mind can not perceive meanings as unique random “particle” identity but perceives meanings as “wave” like fuzzy identities, and hence, it should be possible to point towards the direction of meaning.
मान = fish until pull
बध् = bind pull carry
दान् = throw/roll upto the pull
शान् = stake upto the pull
भ्य = steady connect (gather)
दीर्घ = give/toll/throw inward flow hunt
च = knot
अभ्यास  = here stand + gather (wait/be) untill + fishing net
स्य = gather/be connect
सन् = gather pull / be pull
Meaning Level 1
मान्बधदान्शान्भ्यो = upto (length of) fish (मा), restrain pull (न्ब), carry (ध), give upto (दा), pull upto long (न्शा), separate from pull of steady copulation (rope passing thru opening) (न्भ्यो)
दीर्घश्चाभ्यासस्य = throw/roll inward superior  hunt net (ञ् is assumed) long repeat upto  stand join upto gather furrow join
Meaning Level 2
pull till fish (gets) restrained, carry (on) give pull upto long until separate from standing  join.
throw  inward superior hunting net long repeat upto  stand join upto linejoin line
Meaning Level 3
(picking up from previous instructions) pull apart (separateओ) standing, join and give pull long upto (the length where) fish pulling (out) (is) restricted. repeat upto stading  join  from line to line (and) throw superior hunting (net thus made)
